# Templates

Templates used by the agentic corpus pack.

| Directory | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `feature-folder/` | Standard six-file feature structure. |
| `prod-knowledge/` | Atomic production knowledge templates. |
| `mcp/` | Connected source references. |
| `patterns/` | Reusable markdown patterns. |
| `corpus-skeleton/` | Initial corpus scaffolding helpers. |

The templates are stack-neutral unless explicitly named otherwise.

## Information source templates

Use `information-source/source-profile.yaml.template` and `information-source/sql-readonly-query.md.template` when onboarding custom sources such as MariaDB log databases, internal APIs or exports.
